read_commands: /bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '*prettier*' -g '*package*' -g '*AGENTS.md' -g '*nvm*' -g '*lock*'" | /bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'prettier-plugin|prettierrc|\\.nvmrc' . --glob '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' --glob '"'!yarn.lock'"'" | /bin/bash -lc 'pwd; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f | head -100' | /bin/bash -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print; grep -RInE 'prettier-plugin|prettierrc|\\.nvmrc' src script docs .prettierrc.json package.json --exclude-dir=node_modules" | /bin/bash -lc 'cat .prettierrc.json package.json; find src -type f | sort' | /bin/bash -lc "cat src/steps/writing/creation/rootFiles.ts src/steps/finalizeDependencies.ts src/steps/finalizeDependencies.test.ts src/steps/writing/creation/writePackageJson.ts src/steps/writing/creation/index.ts src/steps/writing/writeStructure.ts; sed -n '1,100p' pnpm-lock.yaml; sed -n '70,95p'  | /bin/bash -lc "grep -RInE 'rootFiles|finalizeDependencies|prettier-plugin|\\.prettierrc' src/steps/writing/*.test.ts src/create/createWithOptions.ts src/migrate/migrateWithOptions.ts src/initialize/initializeWithOptions.ts script/__snapshots__ --exclude-dir=node_modules"
